newsitem.title: USA: AlliedSignal Inc to acquire films company.
newsitem.headline: AlliedSignal Inc to acquire films company.

text.p: AlliedSignal Inc said on Tuesday that it plans to buy Gomar Manufacturing Co Inc, a privately held plastic films company, for an undisclosed dollar amount.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed, but AlliedSignal said it expected to close the deal in a matter of weeks.

Gomar, with manufacturing operations in Linden and Cranbury, N.J., will merge into AlliedSignal's Specialty Films business unit, a film manufacturer for the pharmaceutical, medical and food markets, AlliedSignal said in a statement.
Gomar has annual sales of roughly $50 million, AlliedSignal said.
